description: This file defines a proxy-based stub object for a plugin SDK, providing default behaviors for various property accesses and method calls.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Returns the stub object when the proxy is called as a function.

methods.name: construct
methods.description: Returns the stub object when the proxy is used with 'new'.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Handles property access on the proxy, returning default or special values based on the property name.

methods.name: ownKeys
methods.description: Provides a list of property keys, including special keys '__esModule' and 'default'.

methods.name: getOwnPropertyDescriptor
methods.description: Returns property descriptors for special properties '__esModule' and 'default', or defers to Reflect.
